chunks: And We made the day for seeking livelihood.
ai.seo_question: What is the purpose of the day according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Naba (78:11) is often interpreted alongside its counterpart regarding night (78:10) to establish a balanced rhythm of life, where the day is divinely ordained for productive labor and societal contribution. Scholars emphasize that this 'means of livelihood' (ma'ash) is not merely for individual survival but serves as a test of gratitude and diligence, encouraging believers to engage in lawful trade and work while maintaining spiritual awareness. This framework underscores the Islamic principle that physical activity during daylight is an act of worship when performed with the right intention.
